sponsored.t: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; implements the agreements between the state and the public employees federation.

sponsored.t: Relates to energy efficiency and weatherization
sponsored.ls: New York State Energy Research and Development Act
sponsored.sum: Directs NYSERDA to issue a request for proposals to identify cities, towns, or villages that are interested in participating in municipal-level energy efficiency and weatherization pilot projects to help decrease residential energy usage and reduce future capital costs for utilities; directs NYSERDA to identify three pilot areas focusing on the ability to replicate projects elsewhere and the costs and benefits to ratepayers both in the affected area and in the rest of the utility service territory.

sponsored.t: Relates to lights for bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires any person, firm, association or corporation selling or leasing bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in NYS to affix front and rear lights.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the issuance of delivery tickets electronically
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the issuance of delivery tickets electronically.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child.

sponsored.t: Requires certain utility corporations to refund ratepayers when their achieved return on equity exceeds authorized rates of return by fifty percent
sponsored.sum: Requires certain investor-owned gas or electric corporations to refund ratepayers when their achieved return on equity exceeds authorized rates of return by fifty percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to standards relating to hydrofluorocarbon substances
sponsored.sum: Relates to standards relating to hydrofluorocarbon substances; provides that any rules or regulations relating to hydrofluorocarbon substances established or implemented by the department of environmental conservation shall conform with, and shall not exceed, any applicable rules or regulations set forth in 40 C.F.R. Part 84, as in effect on October first, two thousand twenty-five.

sponsored.t: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters
sponsored.sum: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters; requires that town and village courts share in the compensation of such temporary interpreters.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting the costs of BOCES services and programs from the real property tax levy limit
sponsored.sum: Exempts the costs associated with expenditures resulting from the purchase of BOCES services and programs from the real property tax levy limit.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing compensation for the loss of a fetus
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing compensation for the loss of a fetus; includes the loss of a fetus in the schedule loss of use; provides compensation shall be for 312 weeks.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding early intervention services
sponsored.sum: Relates to funding early intervention services; provides that for the 2025 fiscal year there shall be an 11 percent increase in funding.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of economic development to give a preference to any tourist promotion agency that is promoting the sport of rugby
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of economic development to give a preference to any tourist promotion agency that is promoting the sport of rugby.

sponsored.t: Relates to recoveries from a third-party action
sponsored.sum: Relates to recoveries from a third-party action; provides that liens on recoveries shall be limited to lost wages or medical expenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating the first Friday in February as the New York statewide school day to help people in need
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating the first Friday in February as the "New York statewide school day to help people in need".

sponsored.t: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement
sponsored.sum: Allows for NYSTRS retirees to change their retirement plan beneficiary to a spouse at any time either prior to or after retirement.

sponsored.t: Creates a school budget tax cap exemption for expenditures resulting from settlements or jury awards under the child victims act
sponsored.sum: Creates a school budget tax cap exemption for expenditures resulting from settlements or jury awards for civil actions brought against school districts under the child victims act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the assault on sports officials and aggravated harassment of a sports official and the provision of information to the spectators of such sporting events
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of assault on sports officials and harassment of a sports official; makes harassment of a sports official a violation; requires the state education department to establish an information campaign to be distributed to all youth and school sports programs requiring such programs to disseminate information to parents and other spectators of such programs on the protections afforded sports officials.

sponsored.t: Relates to the salaries of certain teachers and aides employed by boards of cooperative educational services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the salaries of certain teachers and aides employed by boards of cooperative educational services; puts limits on certain administrative and clerical expenses.

sponsored.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional three years.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state seal of financial literacy
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state seal of financial literacy; provides such seal recognizes high school graduates who have attained a high level of proficiency in personal finance, budget management, and investment.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sump pump tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sump pump installation and replacement tax credit for homeowners who use the home as their principal residence and who have an income of less than $250,000.

sponsored.t: Requires that any rules or regulations related to hydrofluorocarbon substances conform with any applicable rules and regulations set by the United States environmental protection agency
sponsored.sum: Requires that any rules or regulations related to hydrofluorocarbon substances conform with, and shall not exceed, any applicable rules and regulations set by the United States environmental protection agency.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"; requires each gas corporation, electric corporation, or combination gas or electric corporation to submit to the public service commission for review and approval at least one and up to ten neighborhood scale weatherization and electrification-ready projects.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state education department to contract for a program related to teacher recruitment and retention
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state education department to contract for a program related to teacher recruitment and retention.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing grants for the implementation of the seal of civic readiness program
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing grants for the implementation of the seal of civic readiness program; authorizes grants of $50,000 to no more than 20 applicant school districts for public schools that have successfully completed both the seal of civic readiness application and commissioner created grant application.

sponsored.t: Relates to persons designated as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to persons designated as peace officers; designates members of the security force employed by Catholic Health Network and Kaleida Health as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Requires social media networks to provide and maintain mechanisms for deleting individual accounts on their platform
sponsored.sum: Requires social media networks to provide and maintain mechanisms for deleting individual accounts on their platform; requires social media networks to have a clear and concise policy readily available and accessible on their website and application which includes how such social media network will delete individual user accounts and all associated personal data on their platform.

sponsored.t: Relates to retention of records relating to certain acts of alleged misconduct
sponsored.sum: Relates to retention of records relating to certain acts of alleged misconduct for the duration of the statute of limitations.

sponsored.t: Extends the statute of limitations for coroners, coroners' physicians and medical examiners for article 78 proceedings
sponsored.sum: Extends the statute of limitations for coroners, coroners' physicians and medical examiners for article 78 proceedings to ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "State Police Retention act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the State Police Retention act; provides a deferred retirement option plan payable to members and officers of the division of state police.

sponsored.t: Requires license plates for certain bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires the registration and issuance of license plates for bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters that can exceed twenty-eight miles per hour with battery assistance up to and exceeding seven hundred fifty watts.

sponsored.t: Prohibits sellers of ebikes, escooters, motor-driven cycles from selling to persons less than sixteen years of age and establishes licensing requirements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits sellers of bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles from selling to persons less than sixteen years of age; requires valid proof of age at the point of purchase; establishes licensing requirements for bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles that can exceed twenty-eight miles per hour.

sponsored.t: Requires operators of bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles to wear protective head gear
sponsored.sum: Requires operators of bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles to wear protective head gear regardless of age.

sponsored.t: Establishes the buy American, buy union grant program and the buy American, buy union grant fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the buy American, buy union grant program and the buy American, buy union grant fund for the purpose of providing grants to municipal subdivisions to reimburse such municipal subdivisions for the costs of procuring consumer or commercial vehicles which are union-made.

sponsored.t: Relates to the residence of the part-time judge of the city court of Tonawanda
sponsored.sum: Relates to the residence of the part-time judge of the city court of Tonawanda; authorizes the part-time judge of the Tonawanda city court to reside anywhere in Erie county or Niagara county provided such part-time judge's term of office commenced during the two thousand twenty-six calendar year.

sponsored.t: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing
sponsored.sum: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing; defines terms; provides for licensure; authorizes the commissioner of agriculture and markets to grant, suspend or revoke licenses; authorizes civil practice law and rules article 78 proceedings to challenge the actions of such commissioner; authorizes such commissioner or such commissioner's duly authorized representatives to investigate and inspect such retail food stores or warehouses; requires the department of agriculture and markets to assign at least on retail food specialist to each inspection zone; provides for penalties and remedies; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to self-employment assistance programs and other matters
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to self-employment assistance programs and other matters.

sponsored.t: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters
sponsored.sum: Raises the minimum fee for temporary interpreters; requires that town and village courts share in the compensation of such temporary interpreters.
